body:
STORY-1689 PR1 is BLOCKED at the pre-push gate. Not pushed, no PR.
The PR1 forge fix is committed locally: e5b7a77b68 on claude/story-1689 (worktree impl-story-1689). 6 new forge tests pass, and make test-touched passed (231 passed, 0 failed).
make check-ci-fast fails at "Check aida-cli without default features" with this exact error:
  cargo: error: refusing build: target filesystem has 11.0G (2.4%) free, below hard floor (15G); run 'cargo reap --apply' or set AIDA_CARGO_DISK_MIN_GIB=0 to override
The target is /dev/sdd1 (/home/joe/ai/aida/target, 458G of 469G used). A `cargo reap` dry run finds 0 dirs to reap. I have not overridden the floor or deleted anything. Once there is disk room, rerun check-ci-fast in this worktree, then push and open the PR.

FYI for the Q3 ruling (PR2): no check-run is named "Build / Require every CI lane". On origin/main e33fec11d9 the aggregator check-run is "Build (ubuntu-latest)" (the build-result job). "Require every CI lane" is a step inside that job, and steps are not check-runs. I plan to require "Build (ubuntu-latest)" unless you rule otherwise.
subject: BLOCKED: STORY-1689 PR1 pre-push gate (disk floor)
